verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded documents a webhooks infrastructure for driving downstream business logic, including a create-subscription endpoint with selectable subscription_types and a payroll.paid event published when payroll payments will be made. It also documents HMAC payload signing, a verify step with a verification_token, and a webhooks health-check endpoint. Missing for 10: no evidence of employee-onboarded or payment-failed event types, no documented retry/delivery semantics, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
